LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_PillarShot.label: (Raven) Pillar Shot
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_PillarShot.descripti: Fires 8 pillars of tyranny that spread outward to attack enemies.
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_Shockwave.label: (Raven) Shockwave
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_Shockwave.descriptio: Releases a golden shockwave around the caster, dealing massive area damage and stunning enemies.
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_DegradationPillar.de: Fires a Pillar of Degradation leaving a trail of fairy dust toward the target.
LanguageData.Raven_Ability_Binah_DegradationLock.desc: Binds the target with chains of Degradation Lock, greatly reducing their mobility.
